text:
Prompt engineering is a dead end for humans.

It's a search problem better solved by machines.

The agent I built evolves its own instructions and it just beat my hand-tuned version by 12%.

It's a tough ego check.

Trust the eval score, not your intuition.

How much time are you wasting on manual tuning?

#AIEngineering #LLMs #PromptEngineering
